title: 1 Chronicles 7
paragraphs: ⁷ ¹ The sons of Issachar were Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom — four in all. ² Tola's sons were Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Jibsam, and Shemuel. They were heads of their ancestral families. In David's time the number of those descended from Tola who were listed as fighting men was twenty-two thousand six hundred. ³ Uzzi's son was Izrahiah, and Izrahiah's sons were Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah — five of them in all, each a clan leader. ⁴ According to their family records, their forces ready for battle numbered thirty-six thousand men, since they had many wives and children. ⁵ Their relatives throughout all the clans of Issachar were eighty-seven thousand fighting men listed in the genealogical records.

⁶ The sons of Benjamin were Bela, Becher, and Jediael — three. ⁷ Bela's sons were Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri — five of them, all clan leaders and mighty warriors. Their genealogical records listed twenty-two thousand and thirty-four fighting men. ⁸ Becher's sons were Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth — all of these were Becher's sons. ⁹ Their genealogical records by their family trees listed twenty thousand two hundred fighting men who were clan leaders. ¹⁰ Jediael's son was Bilhan, and Bilhan's sons were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

¹¹ All these sons of Jediael, listed as clan leaders and mighty warriors, numbered seventeen thousand two hundred soldiers ready for battle. ¹² Shuppim and Huppim were the sons of Ir; Hushim was the son of Aher.

¹⁶ Maachah the wife of Machir gave birth to a son and named him Peresh; his brother was named Sheresh; and Sheresh's sons were Ulam and Rakem. ¹⁷ The son of Ulam was Bedan. These were the descendants of Gilead son of Machir, son of Manasseh. ¹⁸ His sister Hammoleketh bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah. ¹⁹ Shemida's sons were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

²¹ Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, and also Ezer and Elead — these two were killed by the men of Gath who were natives of that land, because they had come down to raid their livestock. ²² Their father Ephraim mourned for them a long time, and his brothers came to comfort him. ²³ Afterward Ephraim slept with his wife, and she conceived and bore a son. He named the boy Beriah, because tragedy had come upon his house. ²⁴ His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth-horon and Uzzen-sheerah. ²⁵ Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

²⁶ Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son, ²⁷ Non his son, Joshua his son. ²⁸ Their lands and settlements included Bethel and its surrounding towns, and to the east, Naaran, and to the west, Gezer and its towns, as well as Shechem and its towns all the way to Ayyah and its towns. ²⁹ Along the borders of Manasseh were Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. In these lived the descendants of Joseph son of Israel.

³¹ The sons of Beriah were Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith. ³² Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and their sister Shua. ³³ The sons of Japhlet were Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath — these were Japhlet's sons. ³⁴ The sons of Shomer were Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram. ³⁵ The sons of his brother Helem were Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

³⁶ The sons of Zophah were Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah, ³⁷ Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera. ³⁸ The sons of Jether were Jephunneh, Pispah, and Ara. ³⁹ The sons of Ulla were Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia. ⁴⁰ All these were Asher's descendants — clan leaders, outstanding men, and mighty warriors, chief among the princes. Their genealogical records numbered twenty-six thousand fighting men.
